a: A consumer's `gestureSource`, `previewPoseExtra` or `boundsOfPose` silently replaces the ones SceneCanvas wires into its `<Canvas>`
A tool offered by one preset's `build` and a tool of another preset's own, both with one id, never conflict: the own tool always wins, whatever `refines` says
`toolOptions` entries holding an array or object field rebuild every preset's tools on every render
Two presets installing one painter at different priorities resolve silently to the first, where every other node-kind trait conflict throws
A partial scene slot with a key set to `undefined` drops the default `drawOne` or `paintBounds`
b: A partial scene slot with an explicit `undefined` field erases the kit default, so the scene paints nothing
Preset `chromeRules` resolve a conflict in the opposite direction from every other preset merge
The cursor and pick dev HUDs convert through the canvas's own camera over every declared view, so over a `<CanvasView>` panel they show the wrong world point and the wrong hits
The insert preview throws on an image preview whose overlay carries no `extras`
A preset's own tool and another preset's built tool with one id are never merged, so `refines` and the conflict throw do not apply between them
